entries.scope: Not separately formalized: pure-input attainment of minimum output entropy; zero Holevo information implies constant output; a standalone Weyl equality for two distinct channels of different output dimensions. The revised manuscript explicitly excludes arbitrary traced C*-algebra coefficients from its one-pair claim.
